question: Will Trump and Zelensky speak directly — by phone or in person — on October 29 or 30, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Relations are at a low point: Trump has called for Ukraine to get a new president (Oct 10-13) and accuses Zelensky of not wanting peace. The background's claim of an Oct 13 call looks wrong, so the last direct contact was probably around Sept 21-22. On Oct 18 Zelensky spoke only with envoys Witkoff and Kushner about a meeting 'in the coming days', and the US wants technical-level trilateral talks by the end of October. Polymarket prices any Trump-Zelensky contact by Oct 31 at about 41-45% (contract rules not loaded). Spread evenly over the remaining ~12 days, that gives about 9% for a 2-day window; I nudged it up because talks could produce a call inside the window and down because of the hostility.

calls.reconciliation: The runs agreed on the evidence: relations frozen since ~Oct 10, envoy-only contact on Oct 18, no scheduled event Oct 29-30, Polymarket ~0.41 for contact by Oct 31 (wider window). Factual dispute over the claimed Oct 13 call: none of the dossiers confirm it, and a 0.41 market price is inconsistent with a call inside its window if that window started around Sep 30. I treat it as probably not having happened, but cannot verify the contract's start date. Clustering upside is judgment: the meeting discussed is envoy-level and possibly the week of Oct 19, outside the window. I land at 0.08, close to the market-scaled ~7% with a small clustering allowance.
